answer: The bridge test I would run is Knighted customs officer licence with customs service attestation: a licence the service renews after border audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the whisper of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the meadow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
